source.snippet: I am using Claude design, and a lot of times its agent is failing mid-task, with connection errors (not sure if this is connection between me and agent, or between agent in Claude infra and relevant LLM model). When these errors happen: 1. My limits have been consumed already. 2. There is no resume button, there is only retry, which starts again. 3. Even retry fails, then consumes my tokens. I had some chats where I lost 80% my limits by retrying the task, with no luck of completing it.

problem_statement: AI agent platforms consume user quota/tokens on failed or mid-task aborted runs with no resume mechanism, forcing users to restart from scratch and burn through paid limits with no recourse.
target_segment: Paid subscribers of AI agent platforms (Claude, GPT, Cursor, etc.) using agents for complex multi-step tasks — freelancers, developers, and knowledge workers.
notes: User explicitly on a paid plan losing 80% of quota to failed retries. 4 points, 5 comments — some resonance. Buyer signal: paid AI platform subscribers who run long-horizon agent tasks. Opportunity: a middleware or proxy layer that checkpoints agent state, detects failures before quota is consumed, and enables resume — or a monitoring dashboard that surfaces quota burn vs. work completed. Could be sold as a browser extension or API wrapper.
